item.title: Double gold fuels Carbon at Rockwell Rumble against loaded field
item.description: FARMINGTON – The Carbon Dinos wrestling team took on elite competition at the Rockwell Rumble, battling through a massive 70-team field at Western Sports Park. Carbon finished 15th overall with 84 team points, highlighted by two championship performances that stood out among the deep brackets. item.description: PRICE — The Carbon County Chamber of Commerce hosted a ribbon cutting on Jan. 20, 2026, for Colleen’s Sanctuary, previously known as Colleen Quigley Women’s Center.
